title: FX: Reserve managers actively bought EUR in Q2 (IMF COFER

classification.rationale: The note analyses IMF COFER Q2 data on reserve managers' currency allocations, showing active EUR buying and JPY selling and a slight fall in the USD share.
classification.runner_up_reason: The note is framed as an FX piece on official-sector flows, but its subject is reserve manager allocation, which fits the reserves subcategory better.
